A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same V-Attack study, with readable text, equations, figures, tables, and complete supplementary material. Supplementary Sections 7–15 in v1 map to Appendices A–I in v2.

before.justification: v1 reports original feature analyses and adversarial-attack experiments, including benchmark comparisons, component ablations, defense tests, and qualitative examples.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results in Sections 3 and 5 and the appendices, including the numerical comparisons in Tables 1–9.

M1.justification: Section 4 retains the same value-feature extraction, Self-Value Enhancement, text-guided localization and manipulation, loss, and optimization procedure. Algorithms 1–3 and the supplementary multilayer variant are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate local semantic attacks using MS-COCO and ILSVRC2012, with image captioning and COCO-based VQA. The commercial-model evaluations and supplementary cross-model, cross-task, and reasoning examples are retained.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains MF-it, MF-ii, AnyAttack, AdvDiff, SSA-CWA, and M-Attack. Patch-Attack in Table 2, X-Attack in Figure 8, and comparator membership in the supplementary defense tests are also unchanged; newly cited methods are not added to the evaluations.

E3.justification: Both retain 300 COCO images, 1,000 ILSVRC2012 images organized into four 250-image subsets, the same prompts and ternary scoring, and the same model configurations. Optimization steps, crop ranges, perturbation budgets, and supplementary testing procedures are unchanged.

E4.justification: The component ablations in Figures 7–8, multilayer experiment in Table 4, defense tests and parameter sweeps in Tables 5–8, and scorer comparison in Table 9 are unchanged. Feature analyses and supplementary case studies are also retained.

E5.justification: Both retain the same point-estimate reporting and cross-scorer comparison in Table 9. Neither reports repeated-run or seed counts, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests.

E6.justification: Reported numerical results and qualitative examples match throughout both PDFs. For example, Table 1 retains ensemble V-Attack averages of 0.567 CAP and 0.560 VQA, and Table 3 retains GPT-o3 CAP performance of 0.589; supplementary results are likewise unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and objectives in Equations 1–7 and the supplementary entropy formula in Equation 8 are unchanged. No formal assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about disentangled value features, precise local semantic manipulation, the two proposed modules, and an average 36% attack-success improvement. Wording edits do not alter their scientific scope.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning global semantic entanglement, VQA-specific enhancement, transferability, and image quality are retained. The supplementary LLaVA gray-box qualification and discussions of scorer reliability, anomaly detection, and defense robustness are unchanged.

D1.justification: Implementation settings, model specifications, data-construction and scoring prompts, and optimizer pseudocode are retained. Both disclose PyTorch, Ubuntu 22.04, eight RTX 4090 GPUs, and the same code-and-data repository link.

R1.justification: v2 adds five attack, defense, and safety references, numbered 22, 36, 39, 51, and 56, and removes v1's Eyes Closed, Safety On and OpenCLIP references. These limited citation updates leave the substantive positioning and novelty argument largely unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 makes light grammatical edits, corrects 'Conlusion,' adds a corresponding-author note and funding acknowledgment, and relabels supplementary Sections 7–15 as Appendices A–I with updated cross-references. The narrative organization and explanatory coverage remain stable.

P2.justification: Captions for Figures 3, 4, and 6 and Table 1 receive wording edits, while the author footnote and acknowledgment produce localized layout changes. All 21 figures and 11 tables are retained with the same visual content and table structures.

improvement.justification: v2 provides limited editorial polish, updated citations, appendix lettering, and author/funding disclosures, while retaining the same scientific argument, experimental evidence, and reproducibility information. Copyediting is mixed: 'Conlusion' is corrected, but Figure 4's caption changes 'beyond their own' to the incomplete 'beyond their.' These small changes do not establish a meaningful net difference in overall paper quality.
